summary: Caller abandoned after agent used dismissive tone and rushed through questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Summit Home Services. What do you need?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I saw your ad about a free inspection. Can you explain what's included?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It's just a standard check. Are you a homeowner or not?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, but I wanted to understand the process first.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Look, I need your address and phone to continue. We don't have all day.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wow, okay. I think I'll pass.
